image_description: A low-angle shot looking up a narrow, dimly lit wooden staircase. The stairs are made of rough-hewn yellow wood with visible grain and wear. A simple wooden handrail runs along the left side, supported by vertical wooden balusters. The walls are dark, textured plaster or stone. A bright rectangular window is visible at the top of the stairs, creating strong backlighting and shadows.
